response.title: can i use a solar generator to power my house
response.answer:
Yes, you can use a solar generator to power your house. Depending on the generator's capacity, it can power anything from a few essential appliances to your entire home.

The key question is whether you want to use it for emergency backup power or to run your house every day and reduce your electricity bill.

1. Three ways to power your house
Shop

Option 1: Power essential appliances

A portable solar generator can run your refrigerator, Wi-Fi, lights, computers, and other small appliances during an outage.

Typical battery: 2–5 kWh.

Shop

Option 2: Power most or all of your house

Larger systems can connect to your electrical panel using an approved transfer switch or home integration equipment.

Typical battery: 10–30+ kWh, depending on your needs.

Shop

Option 3: Run your home on solar every day

A rooftop solar system combined with batteries can provide daily electricity, reduce grid consumption, and potentially support off-grid operation.

This generally requires a larger, permanently installed system.

2. How big a solar generator do you need?

There are two different specifications:

Power (kW): How many appliances you can run simultaneously.

Battery capacity (kWh): How long those appliances can run.

For example, a 10 kWh battery powering an average 500-watt load would theoretically last 20 hours, or somewhat less after conversion losses.

3. Estimate your battery size

Here's a calculator for how long a battery might power your home.

Battery capacity

Average household load

500 W

Estimated battery runtime

17.0 hours
Assumes 85% usable energy, no solar recharging, and a constant load.

Solar panels can extend runtime during daylight, but actual production depends on sunlight, panel size, and weather.

Important: Never plug a solar generator into a regular wall outlet to power house wiring. Use a compatible, professionally installed transfer switch or approved home backup system to prevent dangerous backfeeding. 
OSHA
+1

4. What are you trying to accomplish?

What's your main goal?

Power my house during outages
Reduce my monthly electricity bill
Run my house entirely on solar power

What type of home?

Single-family house
Townhouse
Apartment or condo
Recommend a setup

With those details, I can help you determine whether a portable solar generator is enough or whether a whole-home solar battery system makes more sense.
